title: SAML connector concierge: adaptive entity resolution, cert-timeline validation, and audit-context propagation
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a SAML connector "concierge" to improve onboarding success and reliability by (1) adaptively resolving IdP entity aliases to a canonical internal entity, (2) validating certificate lifecycles and surfacing rotation/expiry warnings during setup, and (3) propagating connector context into audit logs for improved incident triage. This ticket covers the backend validation service, new preflight dry-run behavior, and Console admin UX changes for interactive remediation hints.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight endpoint returns a deterministic canonicalEntityId for at least 95% of sampled IdP metadata variants (aliases, whitespace/case differences, federation prefixes).
Certificate timeline validation flags: expired, not-yet-valid, expiring-within-30-days, rotation-scheduled (based on SAML metadata or admin-provided schedule).
Dry-run mode simulates full assertion exchange using sampled assertions from admin and produces a structured report with suggested fixes and one-click remediation links where safe.
Audit events generated on connector create/update/delete include connector_key, canonicalEntityId, validation_result_code, and preflight_report_url in structured fields (not free text).
Console shows validation findings inline with clear severity, remediation steps, and a 'Run preflight again' button. Admins can mark findings as accepted or create a follow-up ticket.
Automated e2e tests cover XML signature verification, canonicalization variants, entity aliasing, and certificate timeline scenarios.
Production rollout gated behind a feature flag and telemetry confirms <5% increased setup latency for first-time dry-run calls and no regression in SSO login success rate.
implementation_notes: Create a new microservice 'saml-concierge' that accepts metadata URL/upload and returns canonicalEntityId, validation findings, and a signed preflight report blob.

Adaptive entity resolution algorithm: normalize entityID (trim, to-lower, remove common federation prefixes), match against alias patterns stored in connector-index; fallback to discovery heuristics (EntityDescriptor NameIDPolicy hints, assertion consumer URL patterns).

Certificate timeline validation: parse KeyDescriptor elements, extract X509Certificate subject/issuer and validity (if present in metadata extensions) and support admin-provided rotation schedules; mark warnings for overlapping keys and upcoming expiry.

Dry-run: provide a simulation harness that can accept an admin-uploaded sample SAMLResponse (base64 xml) and run through signature verification, audience/issuer checks, attribute mapping, and RBAC-V2 mapping rules. Results in structured JSON with line-item codes.
Audit propagation: extend audit-log schema to include connector_context object (connector_key, canonical_entity, preflight_id, validation_summary). Ensure fields are indexed for searching in ELK.

Console changes: validation sidebar component, two-state remediation workflow (suggested -> accepted), copyable preflight report link. Add UX hints for clock-skew, time servers, and certificate replacement steps.

Security: run XML canonicalization and signature verification using vetted libraries (no homegrown XML parsing). Ensure sandboxing of uploaded artifacts; short-lived tokens for preflight. Feature flag for enabling dry-run for orgs.
test_plan: Unit tests for normalization heuristics with 100+ synthetic entityID variants (case, punctuation, federation prefixes).
Integration tests: sample metadata files from 10 major IdPs (Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin, Ping, ADFS, Shibboleth) run through preflight and dry-run.
Fuzz tests: malformed XML, duplicated KeyDescriptor, nested Signature nodes to ensure robust failure modes.
Load test: 200 preflight calls/min sustained to ensure concierge service autoscaling and <300ms median response under nominal load.
Canary: enable feature-flag for 5% of orgs with telemetry to capture setup success rate, dry-run false positives, and preflight latency.
rollout_plan: Merge backend and console changes behind 'saml_concierge' feature-flag.
Deploy concierge service to staging and run integration suite against staging Console.
Enable feature-flag for internal Redwood orgs and run migration checklist with SRE and Support.
Canary: enable for 5% of customer orgs, monitor metrics for 72h. If no regressions, increase to 25% then 100% across hosted. For Private installs, publish operator upgrade notes.
Post-rollout: run a 30-day audit comparing preflight findings to later production login incidents to measure reduction in onboarding issues.
risks_and_mitigation: False positives in validation might block legitimate connectors — mitigation: allow admins to mark 'accepted' and skip until next metadata change.
Processing uploaded artifacts could be abused — mitigation: sandbox parsing, size limits, and aggressive timeouts.
Increased latency for setup flows — mitigation: asynchronous preflight with a synchronous quick-check; show progress UI and don't block save by default.
Canonicalization heuristics might mismatch for complex federations — mitigation: include rawEntityId in report and allow manual override with audit trail.
